header.name: Graph Theory
header.description: This course is aimed at giving students an introduction to the theory of graphs. The course will introduce concepts that are widely used such as matchings, colorings, etc and study relations between various graph parameters such as matching number, chromatic number, clique number, etc. The emphasis will be on common proof techniques, and applying them to prove properties of graphs in general and for specific families of graphs.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Know elementary structural properties and be able to evaluate them for some simple graph classes

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Know about fundamental graph parameters and be able to calculate them for graph classes

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Know about connectivity, matchings, cuts and flows, coloring, planarity

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Write simple proofs based on the properties of the graphs and stabdard theorems

lecture_topics: Elementary notions: degree, directed, undirected, bipartite, complete, trees, cycles, paths, graphic sequence, isomorphism, spanning trees etc.
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems

lecture_topics: Connectivity: Menger's theorem, notions such as strong connectivity, cut edges, cut vertices, bridges, finding blocks, etc.
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems

lecture_topics: Matching (and covering): Hall's theorem, Konig's theorem, vertex cover, matching in bipartite graphs, matching in general graphs, factors
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems

lecture_topics: Cuts and Flows: max-flow/min-cut: Ford-Fulkerson Theorem
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems

lecture_topics: Coloring: vertex coloring- chromatic number, clique number, independence number, clique cover, Brook's theorem, d-degeracy
existence of triangle-free graphs with arbitrarily large chromatic number
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems

lecture_topics: Planarity: plane graphs, Kuratowski's theorem, dualilty, testing planarity, Euler's formula, 5-coloring planar graphs
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems
Homework, tutorial, quiz consisting of related short problems

lecture_topics: Spectral graph theory (optional if time permits)
